---
name: New topic request
about: Suggest a new module, section, scenario, or reference table
title: "[request] <short description>"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What are you proposing?

Describe in two or three sentences. Be specific. "Add more on AI" is too broad. "Add a scenario covering EU AI Act conformity assessment for a high-risk system" is actionable.

## Who is the audience?

- [ ] 🟢 Non-tech beginners
- [ ] 🟡 Career-shifters
- [ ] 🔴 Tech professionals
- [ ] All

## Where would it live?

- [ ] New module under `modules/`
- [ ] Section within an existing module: _________
- [ ] New scenario in `modules/17-practice-scenarios.md`
- [ ] New template in `scenarios/templates/`
- [ ] Addition to an existing reference table: _________
- [ ] Other: _________

## Why is it worth adding?

What does the reader gain that they cannot get from existing modules or external sources? If a strong external resource already covers this, link it instead.

## Are you offering to write it?

- [ ] Yes: I will draft it and submit a PR.
- [ ] Yes: with guidance from the maintainer.
- [ ] No: I am suggesting the topic only.

If yes, please confirm you have read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../../CONTRIBUTING.md), in particular the **Voice and style** section.

## Anything else

Optional: source material, examples, related issues.
